content.title: Center Trigger | Radial World Change and Residue
content.summary: A single center-anchored action converts a one-versus-many scale problem into a large radial restructuring of the existing environment. The outward boundary must precede physical geometry change, and the aftermath must retain the actor at the original center while surrounding objects remain spatially accountable.

quick_start.input_format: Show one clearly located central actor or initiator against a much larger distributed opposing field before activation. + One physical contact or control action visibly starts an outward radial signal; existing terrain/structure changes only after that signal reaches it. + Finish with a wide view that retains the original center and proves a changed large-scale geometry around it.
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult greenhouse engineer presses one central floor control while autonomous pest-collection machines approach but stop on a permanent outer safety platform before activation; an amber warning ring travels across the existing floor and the segmented substrate descends into a circular quarantine basin, leaving the machines on the undescending outer platform and the engineer supported on a stable center platform whose control descends with it.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A single center-anchored action converts a one-versus-many scale problem into a large radial restructuring of the existing environment. The outward boundary must precede physical geometry change, and the aftermath must retain the actor at the original center while surrounding objects remain spatially accountable.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: A single center-anchored action converts a one-versus-many scale problem into a large radial restructuring of the existing environment. The outward boundary must precede physical geometry change, and the aftermath must retain the actor at the original center while surrounding objects remain spatially accountable.

invariants.rule: Show one clearly located central actor or initiator against a much larger distributed opposing field before activation.
invariants.purpose: Scale establishes the problem and fixes the origin.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a stable center and surrounding field, radial consequence has no readable before state.

invariants.rule: One physical contact or control action visibly starts an outward radial signal; existing terrain/structure changes only after that signal reaches it.
invariants.purpose: Preserves cause before effect and direction of propagation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random cuts or pre-existing deformation break the actor-to-world causal chain.

invariants.rule: Finish with a wide view that retains the original center and proves a changed large-scale geometry around it.
invariants.purpose: Makes the action's consequence measurable by composition.
invariants.ablation_failure: A close-up ending or swapped geography leaves the structural result unproven.

slots.name: initiator
slots.constraint: One stable center actor/controller with a visible single trigger.

slots.name: distributed_field
slots.constraint: A much larger visible group or hazard before activation; avoid source army.

slots.name: terrain_system
slots.constraint: Existing floor or landscape with physical material continuity.

slots.name: propagation
slots.constraint: One outward-moving boundary preceding each structural change.

slots.name: geometry_result
slots.constraint: Large-scale radial structure demonstrably different at the end.

slots.name: camera
slots.constraint: Before wide scale, close trigger, overhead progression, wide result.

slots.name: sound
slots.constraint: Original sound may track trigger and progressive structure; no source audio attribution.

anti_copy_exclusions: No wizard, staff, armored army, siege beasts, gold rune circle, dark-fantasy battlefield or copied sky treatment.
Do not reproduce the source exact crater shot or creator's long live-page prompt as if it were hash-bound prompt evidence.
No unexplained destruction of people or buildings; new structures and affected objects remain physically accountable.

instantiations.concept: An adult greenhouse engineer presses one central floor control while autonomous pest-collection machines approach but stop on a permanent outer safety platform before activation; an amber warning ring travels across the existing floor and the segmented substrate descends into a circular quarantine basin, leaving the machines on the undescending outer platform and the engineer supported on a stable center platform whose control descends with it.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Original grounded greenhouse quarantine engineering film: adult engineer, advancing collector bots, one amber signal and descending circular substrate basin.

instantiations.concept: In a handmade stop-motion paper theater, one adult stage carpenter taps a center pedal as numerous tiny clockwork dancers approach but stop on a rigid outer stage before activation; a blue line spreads along the paper floor and its existing panels fold downward into concentric stepped rows, leaving the dancers on the unchanged outer stage and the carpenter supported on a stable center platform that keeps the pedal attached.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Original handcrafted paper stop-motion stage: carpenter, clockwork dancers, blue pedal signal and folding concentric floor rows.

failure_modes.failure: Radial terrain change happens before the trigger or appears everywhere simultaneously.
failure_modes.repair: Show contact then traveling boundary then local panel motion in the same geographic axis.

failure_modes.failure: The group or initiator vanishes during the effect.
failure_modes.repair: Return to wide views that keep center and affected edge visible.

failure_modes.failure: Final structure is a disconnected replacement environment.
failure_modes.repair: Use same floor marks/material and preserve actor/objects at recognizable positions.
